title: The Networks
question: Can a network read a company's history?
goals: Learn the terms, fix the seed, load.
Put every ratio on one scale.
Train a small network on the ratios.
Turn each row into five years.
Turn three hazards into a term structure.
Set the networks beside the trees.
Read seven rungs and choose one model.

raw_inputs.name: Feeding a network ratios as they come
raw_inputs.honest_label: ROC-AUC, the same network on transformed ratios
raw_inputs.why: A network adds its inputs up, so one ratio in the thousands drowns the rest. A tree only asks which side of a number a row is on.
